title: Room 1.5 · Sprite (CR 1/4) · Moderate, 50 XP · cleared, untouched
headline: Morten tried talking the Sprite out of the way in Elvish. It wasn't having it, so he won initiative and dropped it with one Magic Missile that rolled exactly its 10 HP.

bullets.label: The room
bullets.text: 8×10 sq (12×15 m), entered through a 1.5 m-wide gap. The owl found a Sprite hovering in the middle, bow in hand.

bullets.label: The parley
bullets.text: a Sprite is a good-hearted fey, so Morten asked in Elvish to be let through. Persuasion 3 vs DC 13 failed, and it drew.

bullets.label: Why Magic Missile
bullets.text: AC 15 and Invisibility make a Sprite hard to hit for long, but Magic Missile never misses. The cast held (24 vs DC 11), and 3d4+3 came to exactly 10 force dmg against 10 HP.

trace.text: Persuasion (in Elvish) 3 vs DC 13: the Sprite refuses.
Magic Missile holds (24 vs DC 11): 3 darts, 10 force dmg. Sprite 10 → 0 HP, dead.

foes.name: Sprite
attacks: Enchanting Bow +6, 8/32 sq (12/48 m), 1 piercing and Charmed
foes.notes: Tiny; casts Invisibility on itself; Stealth +8
